scripts.build: sh -c 'if ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[bridge] skipping go build: go not on PATH (built by the go CI job and the docker images)"; exit 0; fi; GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -buildvcs=false -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/panel-host-bridge ./cmd/panel-host-bridge'
scripts.test: sh -c 'if [ "$(go env GOOS 2>/dev/null)" != linux ]; then echo "[bridge] skipping go test: Linux-only syscalls, run on a Linux host or in CI"; exit 0; fi; go test -race -count=1 ./...'
scripts.lint: sh -c 'go vet ./... || exit 1; unformatted="$(gofmt -l -s .)"; if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then echo "$unformatted"; echo "[bridge] gofmt -s found unformatted files (run: gofmt -w -s .)" >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'if ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[bridge] skipping go typecheck: go not on PATH (compilation is covered by the go CI job)"; exit 0; fi; GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -buildvcs=false -o /dev/null ./...'
